copy.seo_title: Rent a Car With a G2 Licence in Toronto | CarmaCars
copy.meta_description: Yes, a G2 licence is enough to rent from CarmaCars in Toronto. See what you need, how age affects the fee and how to send a request.
copy.h1: Renting a car in Toronto with a G2 licence
copy.intro: Yes, CarmaCars rents to drivers who hold an Ontario G2 licence. The licence class is not what decides the price or the approval. We look at your age, your documents and the car you choose. Send a request with no payment up front, upload your licence photos and a selfie before pickup, and a person on our team checks them. Pick the car at our Toronto location or have it delivered to your address.

sections.heading: What you need to bring
sections.body: Your Ontario G2 licence, valid for the whole rental, and a credit card in your own name. Before pickup you upload photos of your licence and a selfie. We check your licence and identity before the keys are handed over, so it helps to upload them early rather than on the day.

sections.heading: Age matters more than class
sections.body: A G2 driver and a G driver of the same age are treated the same way. If you are under the age where the young driver fee stops, a daily fee is added, and you see it on each car's page before you send your request. Drivers from 18 can rent with us, including drivers aged 18 to 20.

sections.heading: Your G2 conditions still apply
sections.body: The rules on your licence follow you into a rental car, including the zero blood alcohol rule for novice drivers. Keep to them on every trip. If you are not sure which cars suit a newer driver, start with an economy car and compare it with the other options.

sections.heading: Choosing a first rental
sections.body: Economy cars are easy to park and simple to drive around the city. Check the equipment list on each car's page, such as a backup camera or Bluetooth, and use the nearby pages for young drivers and drivers under 25 for more on fees.

faq.question: Can I rent a car with a G2 in Ontario?
faq.answer: Yes. CarmaCars accepts an Ontario G or G2 licence for the cars in the fleet. You also need a credit card in your own name and a licence and identity check before pickup.

faq.question: Does a G2 driver pay more than a G driver?
faq.answer: No. The licence class does not change the price. A young driver fee depends on your age, and it is shown on the car's page before you send a request.

faq.question: Can I rent with a G1 licence?
faq.answer: No. A G1 driver cannot drive alone, so we rent to G and G2 drivers. A G1 holder is welcome to ride along as a passenger.

faq.question: Can a G2 driver be an additional driver?
faq.answer: Yes. An additional driver is checked the same way as the main renter and uploads the same documents.

faq.question: Do I pay when I send the request?
faq.answer: No. You request to book with no payment and pay after we confirm.

copy.seo_title: Car Rental for Rideshare Drivers in Toronto | CarmaCars
copy.meta_description: Rent a car in Toronto to drive for a rideshare or delivery platform. The rental agreement allows it in section 10.3. Weekly and monthly options.
copy.h1: Car rental for rideshare and delivery drivers
copy.intro: If you drive for a rideshare or delivery platform in Toronto, you can do it in a CarmaCars rental. Our rental agreement allows this kind of driving in section 10.3, so you do not need to hide what the car is for. Rent by the week or the month and extend from your account while the car is free. CarmaCars is not affiliated with or endorsed by any platform, which are named only to describe the work.

sections.heading: Allowed in the agreement
sections.body: Section 10.3 of the rental agreement covers rideshare and delivery driving. Tell us in your request which platform you drive for. Only you or an additional driver on the booking may drive the car for that work. Each platform sets its own rules for drivers and vehicles, and meeting them is up to you.

sections.heading: Weekly and monthly rentals
sections.body: Longer rentals suit full-time work behind the wheel. The weekly and monthly rates are on each car's page and in your offer, so you can work out a week of driving before you book. If your plans change, you can extend from your account while the car is free.

sections.heading: Platform approval
sections.body: The platforms decide which cars and drivers they accept. Check their vehicle rules for the car you choose before you book. Once your booking is confirmed, your booking page produces the documents a platform may ask a renter for, and you upload them to the platform yourself.

sections.heading: Tolls, tickets and the tracker
sections.body: The car is tracked by GPS for the whole rental, as the agreement says. Tolls and tickets during your rental are yours, each matched to your booking with the invoice as proof, so you can see what was charged and why before it reaches you.

faq.question: Can I use a rental car for Uber in Toronto?
faq.answer: The CarmaCars rental agreement allows rideshare and delivery driving. The platform decides whether it accepts the car and driver, so check its vehicle rules first.

faq.question: Is CarmaCars affiliated with Uber or Lyft?
faq.answer: No. CarmaCars is not affiliated with or endorsed by any rideshare or delivery platform. They are named only to describe the work.

faq.question: How long can I rent for?
faq.answer: By the week or the month, and you can extend from your account while the car is free.

faq.question: Who can drive the car for work?
faq.answer: Only you or an additional driver listed on the booking. Each driver needs an Ontario G or G2 licence and passes the same checks.

faq.question: Do I pay when I send the request?
faq.answer: No. You send a request to book with no payment and pay after we confirm.

copy.seo_title: Rental Car With a Phone Charger Ready | CarmaCars
copy.meta_description: Add a phone charger to your CarmaCars rental and find it in the car at pickup. Tick it when you send your request in Toronto.
copy.h1: A rental car with a phone charger waiting inside
copy.intro: A flat phone is a bad start to a trip, so CarmaCars lets you add a phone charger to your request. Tick it in the add-ons step and it is in the car when you collect it or when we deliver it. It is one cable with USB-C and Lightning ends, which fits an iPhone or an Android phone. The price appears as its own line in your offer before you pay anything.

sections.heading: How to add it
sections.body: Choose a car, pick your dates and tick the phone charger in the add-ons step of the request. It is shown as a separate line in your offer, so you can see exactly what it adds. You can also add it later from your booking page, while there is still time to put it in the car.

sections.heading: Which ports to expect
sections.body: The cable plugs into a USB port. Each car's page lists its features, so check there for what the car has, such as Bluetooth or a built-in screen, before you decide. If a car has no port where you like to plug in, ask us before you book and we will tell you what we know.

sections.heading: Driving an electric car?
sections.body: Electric cars are handed over with their charging cable, and each car's page says how it charges. The phone charger is a separate add-on for your phone, so tick it as well if you want both a charging cable for the car and a cable for your handset ready on the first day.

sections.heading: Bring it back
sections.body: The charger belongs to CarmaCars and comes back with the car. One that is not returned is charged as the fee schedule says, so leave it in the car with the other items when you hand the keys back at the end of your rental.

faq.question: Does the rental car come with a phone charger?
faq.answer: Add one to your request and it is in the car at pickup: a cable with USB-C and Lightning ends.

faq.question: Can I add a charger after I booked?
faq.answer: Yes, from your booking page before pickup, while there is time to put it in the car.

faq.question: Do the cars have USB ports?
faq.answer: Each car's page lists its features. The cable plugs into a USB port.

faq.question: Is the charger delivered with the car?
faq.answer: Yes. If we deliver the car to your address, the charger is inside when it arrives.

faq.question: Do I pay for it when I send the request?
faq.answer: No. You send a request to book with no payment. The add-on is listed in your offer and you pay after we confirm.

copy.seo_title: Car Rental With a Child Seat in Toronto | CarmaCars
copy.meta_description: Add a baby seat, child seat or booster to your CarmaCars rental in Toronto. It is in the car at pickup, and you install it yourself.
copy.h1: A rental car with a child seat ready for your trip
copy.intro: Travelling with a little one in Toronto? Add a rear-facing baby seat, a forward-facing child seat or a booster to your CarmaCars request, and it is in the car at pickup. The seat is listed in your offer with its price before you pay. We place it in the car and you fit it, because only you know your child's size and the fit you are used to. Take your time before you drive off.

sections.heading: Which seat to choose
sections.body: A baby seat is for infants and faces the rear. A child seat is for toddlers and faces forward. A booster is for older children. Ontario law sets which one your child needs by weight, height and age, so choose by your child and ask us if you are unsure.

sections.heading: You install it
sections.body: We put the seat in the car. You install it and check that it suits your child. Allow a few minutes at handover, and do not leave until you are happy with the fit. If you want a second pair of hands, ask the person at the handover and take the time you need.

sections.heading: Room for the family
sections.body: Two seats plus luggage fit best in an SUV or a minivan. Look at the nearby SUV and minivan pages, then check the number of seats on each car's page, so you know the seat, the bags and every passenger fit before you send the request.

sections.heading: Your own seat is welcome
sections.body: If your child already has a seat you trust, you can bring it. The add-on is there for visitors and for anyone who would rather not carry one on a flight, and it keeps your own seat free for the car you use at home.

faq.question: Can I rent a car with a car seat in Toronto?
faq.answer: Yes. Add a baby seat, a child seat or a booster to any CarmaCars rental when you send your request.

faq.question: How much is a child seat?
faq.answer: Each seat's price is shown on this page and in your offer before you pay.

faq.question: Do you install the seat?
faq.answer: We put it in the car. You install it and check that it suits your child.

faq.question: Can I bring my own seat?
faq.answer: Yes. Your own seat is welcome.

faq.question: Which seat does my child need?
faq.answer: Ontario law sets it by weight, height and age. Choose by your child, and ask us if you are not sure.

copy.seo_title: Car Rental With Flowers in the Car, Toronto | CarmaCars
copy.meta_description: Add flowers to your CarmaCars rental and find a bouquet in the car at pickup or delivery in Toronto. Send a request with no payment.
copy.h1: A rental car with a bouquet waiting inside
copy.intro: Some days call for more than keys. Add flowers to your CarmaCars request and a bouquet is waiting in the car when you collect it or when we deliver it to your address. People choose it for anniversaries, proposals, birthdays and airport pickups. The add-on is listed in your offer before you pay, so there are no surprises on the day.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Tick flowers in the add-ons step of your request, ahead of pickup so we can order the bouquet. The notice we need is shown with the add-on. Add a note about the occasion so the handover fits it, and tell us if the car will be collected by someone else, so the bouquet is in the right place when they arrive.

sections.heading: Make it a surprise
sections.body: Have the car delivered to a home, a hotel or an airport with the bouquet inside. Delivery to any address is available for the car's delivery fee plus distance, and the pickup at our location is the other option. Either way, the bouquet is inside before you arrive, so the surprise is ready the moment the door opens.

sections.heading: Pick a car to match
sections.body: A convertible suits a summer evening, a luxury car suits a dinner out, and an SUV works when the family is coming along. Browse the nearby luxury, convertible and exotic pages for ideas, and check each car's page for its seats and equipment before you choose the one that fits the occasion.

sections.heading: A phone charger too
sections.body: A charger is a handy extra for a long day of photos. It is a separate add-on, and the nearby phone charger page explains it. Add both in the same request and they appear as separate lines in your offer, so you can see each one before you pay.

faq.question: Can I rent a car with flowers in it?
faq.answer: Yes. Add flowers to a CarmaCars rental and the bouquet is in the car at pickup or delivery.

faq.question: How much notice do you need?
faq.answer: Enough to order a fresh bouquet. The notice is shown with the add-on when you send your request.

faq.question: Can you deliver the car with the flowers?
faq.answer: Yes. We deliver to any address for the car's delivery fee plus distance, with the bouquet inside.

faq.question: Can I tell you the occasion?
faq.answer: Yes. Add a note to your request, such as an anniversary or a proposal.

faq.question: Do I pay when I send the request?
faq.answer: No. You send a request to book with no payment and pay after we confirm.
